title: MEMORIAL STONES
JOSHUA 4
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit living room table with open bible
peaceful evening countryside home window glowing softly
old stone wall in quiet garden at dusk
rustic wooden table with vintage family bible and olive branch
gentle riverbank at twilight with smooth river stones
quiet family dining room table bathed in warm lamplight
cozy home interior with open scripture book at night

scenes.a: When tomorrow brings questions from your children,
remember what God has brought you through.
That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.
Lord, help us tell our children of Your mighty acts.
Keep our hearts anchored in Your enduring grace.
Amen. When tomorrow brings questions from your children,
